requirements.title: Risk management system for high-risk AI systems
requirements.requirementText: A risk management system shall be established, implemented, documented and maintained in relation to high-risk AI systems, requiring a continuous iterative process run throughout the entire lifecycle of a high-risk AI system, requiring regular systematic review and updating.

requirements.title: Risk identification and evaluation
requirements.requirementText: The risk management system shall identify and analyse the known and reasonably foreseeable risks that the high-risk AI system can pose to health, safety or fundamental rights when the high-risk AI system is used in accordance with its intended purpose or under conditions of reasonably foreseeable misuse.

requirements.title: Risk mitigation measures
requirements.requirementText: High-risk AI systems shall be tested for the purpose of identifying the most appropriate and targeted risk management measures. Testing shall ensure that high-risk AI systems perform consistently for their intended purpose and that they are in compliance with the requirements set out in Chapter III, Section 2.

requirements.title: Data and data governance
requirements.requirementText: High-risk AI systems which make use of techniques involving the training of AI models with data shall be developed on the basis of training, validation and testing data sets that meet the quality criteria referred to in paragraphs 2 to 5, and that are subject to appropriate data governance and management practices.

requirements.title: Relevant design choices for data sets
requirements.requirementText: Training, validation and testing data sets shall be subject to data governance and management practices appropriate for the intended purpose of the high-risk AI system, including relevant design choices.

requirements.title: Bias examination and mitigation in data sets
requirements.requirementText: Training, validation and testing data sets shall be relevant, sufficiently representative, and to the best extent possible, free of errors and complete in view of the intended purpose. They shall have the appropriate statistical properties, including, where applicable, as regards the persons or groups of persons on which the high-risk AI system is intended to be used.

requirements.title: Technical documentation
requirements.requirementText: The technical documentation of a high-risk AI system shall be drawn up before that system is placed on the market or put into service and shall be kept up-to date. The technical documentation shall be drawn up in such a way as to demonstrate that the high-risk AI system complies with the requirements set out in Chapter III, Section 2.

requirements.title: Record-keeping
requirements.requirementText: High-risk AI systems shall technically allow for the automatic recording of events (logs) over the lifetime of the system. Logging capabilities shall enable the recording of events relevant for identifying situations that may result in the high-risk AI system presenting a risk or in a substantial modification, facilitating the monitoring of the operation of high-risk AI systems.

requirements.title: Transparency and provision of information to deployers
requirements.requirementText: High-risk AI systems shall be designed and developed in such a way as to ensure that their operation is sufficiently transparent to enable deployers to interpret the system's output and use it appropriately. An instruction for use shall be provided with the high-risk AI system.

requirements.title: Human oversight
requirements.requirementText: High-risk AI systems shall be designed and developed in such a way, including with appropriate human-machine interface tools, that they can be effectively overseen by natural persons during the period in which they are in use.

requirements.title: Human oversight measures - understanding
requirements.requirementText: Human oversight measures shall enable individuals to whom human oversight has been assigned to properly understand the relevant capacities and limitations of the high-risk AI system and be able to duly monitor its operation.

requirements.title: Accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity
requirements.requirementText: High-risk AI systems shall be designed and developed in such a way that they achieve an appropriate level of accuracy, robustness, and cybersecurity, and that they perform consistently in those respects throughout their lifecycle.

requirements.title: Quality management system
requirements.requirementText: Providers of high-risk AI systems shall put a quality management system in place that ensures compliance with this Regulation. That system shall be documented in a systematic and orderly manner in the form of written policies, procedures and instructions, and shall include at least the aspects listed in paragraph 2.

requirements.title: Fundamental rights impact assessment
requirements.requirementText: Prior to deploying a high-risk AI system, deployers that are bodies governed by public law or are private entities providing public services shall perform an assessment of the impact on fundamental rights that the use of such system may produce.

requirements.title: Classification of general-purpose AI models as general-purpose AI models with systemic risk
requirements.requirementText: A general-purpose AI model shall be classified as a general-purpose AI model with systemic risk if it has high impact capabilities evaluated on the basis of appropriate technical tools and methodologies, or based on a decision of the Commission.

requirements.title: Obligations for providers of general-purpose AI models
requirements.requirementText: Providers of general-purpose AI models shall draw up and keep up-to-date the technical documentation of the model, including its training and testing process and the results of its evaluation, contain, at a minimum, the elements set out in Annex XI.

requirements.title: Obligations for providers of general-purpose AI models with systemic risk
requirements.requirementText: In addition to the obligations listed in Articles 53 and 54, providers of general-purpose AI models with systemic risk shall perform model evaluations in accordance with standardised protocols and tools reflecting the state of the art, including conducting and documenting adversarial testing of the model.

requirements.title: Post-market monitoring by providers and post-market monitoring plan for high-risk AI systems
requirements.requirementText: Providers shall establish and document a post-market monitoring system in a manner that is proportionate to the nature of the AI technologies and the risks of the high-risk AI system.

requirements.title: Classification rules for high-risk AI systems
requirements.requirementText: An AI system shall be considered high-risk where both of the following conditions are fulfilled: (a) the AI system is intended to be used as a safety component of a product, or the AI system is itself a product covered by Union harmonisation legislation; (b) the product whose safety component is the AI system, or the AI system itself as a product, is required to undergo a third-party conformity assessment.

requirements.title: Amendments to Annex III
requirements.requirementText: The Commission is empowered to adopt delegated acts to amend Annex III by adding or modifying use cases of high-risk AI systems where both of the conditions laid down in Article 6(3) are fulfilled.

requirements.title: Compliance with the requirements
requirements.requirementText: High-risk AI systems shall comply with the requirements established in Chapter III, Section 2, taking into account their intended purpose as well as the generally acknowledged state of the art.

requirements.title: Obligations of providers of high-risk AI systems
requirements.requirementText: Providers of high-risk AI systems shall ensure that their systems are compliant with the requirements set out in Chapter III, Section 2, indicate their name, registered trade name or trademark and contact address on the system, and have a quality management system in place.

requirements.title: User information
requirements.requirementText: Providers shall ensure that high-risk AI systems bear the required CE marking and are accompanied by the EU declaration of conformity and instructions for use in a language easily understood by deployers.

requirements.title: Corrective actions and duty of information
requirements.requirementText: Providers of high-risk AI systems which consider or have reason to consider that a high-risk AI system is not in conformity with the requirements shall immediately take the necessary corrective actions, withdraw it, disable it, or recall it, as appropriate.

requirements.title: Cooperation with competent authorities
requirements.requirementText: Providers of high-risk AI systems shall, upon a reasoned request by a competent authority, provide that authority with all the information and documentation necessary to demonstrate the conformity of the high-risk AI system.

requirements.title: Authorised representatives of providers
requirements.requirementText: Prior to making their high-risk AI systems available on the Union market, providers established in third countries shall, by written mandate, appoint an authorised representative which is established in the Union.

requirements.title: Responsibilities along the AI value chain
requirements.requirementText: Any distributor, importer, deployer or other third-party shall be considered a provider of a high-risk AI system and subject to the obligations of the provider where they put their name or trademark on a high-risk AI system, substantially modify it, or change its intended purpose.

requirements.title: Obligations of deployers of high-risk AI systems
requirements.requirementText: Deployers of high-risk AI systems shall take appropriate technical and organisational measures to ensure they use such systems in accordance with the instructions for use, assign human oversight, and ensure that input data is relevant and sufficiently representative.

requirements.title: Conformity assessment
requirements.requirementText: High-risk AI systems shall undergo a conformity assessment procedure prior to their being placed on the market or put into service, in order to demonstrate compliance with the requirements set out in Chapter III, Section 2.

requirements.title: CE marking
requirements.requirementText: The CE marking shall be affixed visibly, legibly and indelibly for high-risk AI systems. It shall be subject to the general principles set out in Article 30 of Regulation (EC) No 765/2008.

requirements.title: EU declaration of conformity
requirements.requirementText: Providers shall draw up a written machine readable, physical or electronically signed EU declaration of conformity for each high-risk AI system, and keep it at the disposal of the national competent authorities for 10 years after the AI system has been placed on the market.

requirements.title: Registration
requirements.requirementText: Before placing on the market or putting into service a high-risk AI system, providers shall register the system in the EU database referred to in Article 71.

requirements.title: Transparency obligations for certain AI systems
requirements.requirementText: Providers shall ensure that AI systems intended to interact directly with natural persons are designed and developed in such a way that natural persons are informed that they are interacting with an AI system, unless this is obvious from the point of view of a natural person.

requirements.title: Transparency obligations for providers and users
requirements.requirementText: Providers and users of certain AI systems shall comply with transparency obligations including disclosure when content is generated by AI, subject to the conditions and exceptions laid down in this Article.

requirements.title: EU database for high-risk AI systems
requirements.requirementText: The Commission shall create and maintain an EU database containing information concerning high-risk AI systems registered in accordance with Article 49, accessible to the public where appropriate.

requirements.title: Reporting of serious incidents
requirements.requirementText: Providers of high-risk AI systems placed on the Union market shall report any serious incident to the market surveillance authority of the Member State where the incident occurred, without undue delay and in any event within the timeframe specified in this Article.
